Crude Oil WTI (CL) was at $82.76 and Brent Oil (LCO) at $92.15 as of Nov 19, 3:06 PM EST. WTI is down about 16% over one month and 23% over six months. It is still up roughly 44% year to date and 39% over one year. The 52-week high for WTI was $117.63. Small-business costs therefore reflect a year-long climb, not just today’s price.
